verifiedNote: Every privacyUrl and dpaUrl was opened on this date and was the company's own page (OpenAI blocks scripted requests, so those two were opened in a real browser). The transfers flags record only what the company's own page said on that date: sccs = it names standard contractual clauses, dpf = it names the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Where a page did not say, the flag is false and the generated text says nothing about it. Run this check again before a release.

services.name: Supabase
services.purpose: Stores accounts and everything you save, and handles sign-in
services.dataShared: Email, password (scrambled, never readable), profile, saved content
services.location: The region chosen when the app was set up

services.name: Vercel
services.purpose: Hosts the app and delivers its pages
services.dataShared: Technical information about each visit, such as IP address and browser type
services.location: Servers around the world, mainly in the United States

services.name: Resend
services.purpose: Sends the emails the app needs to send, such as sign-up confirmation and password reset
services.dataShared: Your email address and the text of the email
services.location: United States, with sending servers in the EU or the US depending on the region chosen

services.name: Stripe
services.purpose: Takes payments for paid plans and handles refunds, invoices and fraud checks
services.dataShared: Name, email, payment details you enter at checkout, plan and payment history

services.name: OpenAI
services.purpose: Runs the AI features: it reads what you send to them and writes the answer
services.dataShared: The text, files or questions you send to an AI feature

services.name: OpenRouter
services.purpose: Passes what you send to an AI feature on to the company that runs the AI model, and brings the answer back
services.dataShared: The text, files or questions you send to an AI feature
services.location: United States and other countries, depending on the AI model used

services.name: Google
services.purpose: Lets you sign in with your Google account
services.dataShared: Your name and email address, sent to us by Google when you choose to sign in with Google

services.name: PostHog
services.purpose: Shows us how the app is used, such as which pages are opened and which buttons are pressed
services.dataShared: Pages viewed, actions taken, device and browser type, and a random ID stored in your browser
services.location: The EU or the United States, depending on the region chosen when it was set up

services.name: Upstash
services.purpose: Keeps short-lived counters, for example to slow down abuse
services.dataShared: An IP address or account ID, for a short time
services.location: The region chosen when it was set up

services.name: Sentry
services.purpose: Collects error reports so faults can be found and fixed
services.dataShared: Technical details of an error: the page, browser type, IP address and the error message
services.location: The United States or Germany, depending on the region chosen when it was set up
